title: Out of range guard
prompt: Return the item at position i, or "none" if i is not a valid position (negative or too big).
hints: A position is valid when it is at least 0 and less than the size.

docs.name: list[i]
docs.what: The item at position i. Positions start at 0; -1 is the last item.

docs.name: list.size()
docs.what: Returns how many items the array holds.
